summary.answer: Builds the heal-cooldown HUD. State-condition closures, powerRatio/shader links, input-source updates and close hook are conditional callbacks. Flare/pulse Full states test powerRatio==1; the KBM ability prompt is true only on the explicit ability branch. Parent state/ammo callbacks can play Pulse when PowerBased and ShouldPulseNewAmmo. The tail registers close, conditionally calls PostLoadFunc and returns.
